title: A High-Throughput Toolkit for Cryo-EM Analysis of Lipid Nanoparticles Using Machine Learning
content: Cryoelectron microscopy (cryo-EM) is a powerful technique where samples including biological membranes and lipids are vitrified in liquid. Unlike conventional EM this allows high-resolution imaging under near-native conditions of macromolecules as well as mRNA and proteins [1].
